items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: Joe Collins was playing guitar, and Palm... Truck Palm was playing the bass.

ctx.x: Yes. I'll just, would you tell us about the records? Well, just tell us what you know about Jelly Roll, will you, Mr. Mason?

Well, I'll tell you, Jelly, Jelly Roll, my first meeting with him, he came to our band, came to Faith Marley's band to make a tour out in Ohio. About when? Yeah, that was in about 1927, I think. Yeah, 1927. No, 26 it was. Of course, and we were out there. He was my roommate, of course. We'd travel around, and he used to play and tell me about his numbers. In fact, I knew about a lot of the numbers he wrote. I used to play the Pearls and Grandpa Spells and Mylon Book Joys and several other tunes he played, and of…
And then... You went on a tour with him?
